correctness.rationale: PASS: Tame (Z/2)^4 quotient decomposition gives a prime-to-11-degree isogeny of the genus-five Jacobian to five Legendre elliptic factors; prime-to-p isogeny preserves their 11-divisible groups. Their supersingularity is exactly vanishing of H(T)=sum_(j=0)^5 binom(5,j)^2 T^j=(T-2)(T+1)(T+5)(T²-T+1) mod11; five simple roots all lie in F121, three in F11. Independent GF121 arithmetic checked all 20 ordered pairs of distinct H-roots and verified the other three quotient cross ratios remain nonsupersingular; label permutations of the five branch points transitively carry any distinct quotient divisor pair to this tested pair, proving no triple and 20 transverse points per pair. Inclusion-exclusion on marked parameter space produces all-extension formulas. Independent complete enumeration at q=11,121 returned (12,0,60) and (11292,2550,200).
